# Vangcur (ভাঙচুর) — Gadgets & Accessories

> Vangcur is a premier e-commerce brand in Bangladesh specializing in unique gadgets, RGB lighting, crystal items, lifestyle tech, and mobile accessories with fast home delivery and warranty support across all 64 districts.

## About Vangcur
- Official Website: https://vangcur.com
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Customer Support WhatsApp: +8801816365504
- Customer Support Email: vangcurbd@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/vangcurbdofficial

## Product Categories
- RGB Lights & Neon Lights: Ambient LED decor, custom neon desk lights, and smart lighting solutions.
- TWS Earbuds & Headphones: Wireless Bluetooth earphones, neckbands, and audio gear.
- Power Banks & Charging Accessories: Fast chargers, high-capacity portable power banks, and durable cables.
- Smart Watches: Health tracking, fitness monitoring, and lifestyle smartwatches.
- Crystal Balls & Lamps: Decorative crystal art lamps, Moon lamps, and acrylic night lights.
- Desk Fans & Humidifiers: Rechargeable cooling fans, desk mist humidifiers, and lifestyle electronics.
- Unique Tools & Tech Gadgets: Portable mini printers, unique utility tools, and desktop gadgets.

## Delivery & Shipping Policies
- Coverage: Entire Bangladesh (all 64 districts).
- Delivery Partner: Pathao Courier.
- Inside Dhaka City: 1–3 business days (Shipping charge: 90 BDT).
- Outside Dhaka / All Bangladesh: 2–5 business days (Shipping charge: 130 BDT).
- Method: Closed-box home delivery with Cash on Delivery (COD) for the remaining balance.

## Payment Policy
- Advance Payment: A nominal advance of 200 BDT is verified via bKash Send Money to confirm orders and prevent fake bookings.
- Remaining Balance: Cash on Delivery (COD) paid to the delivery person upon arrival.

## Warranty & Replacement Policy
- Replacement Warranty: Standard 7-day to 6-month replacement warranty on products (specified on each product page).
- Condition: A continuous, unedited unboxing video from parcel receipt is mandatory for warranty claims.
- Return Policy: Full replacement provided at Vangcur's expense for manufacturing defects, transit damage, or incorrect products. No returns for change of mind or personal preference.
